winnerId.description: ID of the KB entry the merged code (or trust tier) supports. Ends confidence=CONFIRMED with flags cleared; stale is cleared only if the D2 un-stale predicate holds post-flag-clear.

loserId.description: ID of the KB entry the merged code contradicts. Ends superseded_at=now, stale=1, flagged_for_review cleared. Never deleted.

evidence.description: Evidence note appended to the winner content, e.g. a file+symbol citation or the trust-tier rule applied. Verbatim "hash-basis match on merged worktree" when called by kb_reconcile_prefilter.
